title: Framing
body:
Git and Github-centric framing  
1. A new layout of organizing agent memory, workflows, as well as user rubrics 
2. Better human agent collaboration workflow 
    - cleaner session management and task execution and reviewing 
3. Code anywhere and it will always run 

Agent framing 
1. long running agent framing -> we have the orchestrator agent that can break down tasks and perform extremely long running cases 
2. personalization and grow with user framing and even including #174 

Self-improving framing
1. use agent to improve its infra to improve its generation?
